suite: the model drawn alone (the end-stop model's parts only, one light on the tree, the grid, the map and the scene)
expect_red: [real] a part hovered in the tree lights the same thing on all four surfaces, in two tiers: its own rows, pins, jumpers and box strong and its interfaces faint; in the scene its mesh glows at its resting look with its bound faces harder, every other part faint, nothing opaque

mutations.contract: A part's bound faces are overlaid harder than the part (Jeff: "even more prominently than the entire part").
mutations.note: Declared by handoff hover_and_select_light_the_same_things_on_all_four_surfaces_and_nothing_goes_opaque. The face drawn no harder than the part.
mutations.find: hover: { color: HOVER_COLOR, own: { part: 0.22, face: 0.6 }, touching: { part: 0.08, face: 0.25 } },
mutations.replace: hover: { color: HOVER_COLOR, own: { part: 0.6, face: 0.6 }, touching: { part: 0.08, face: 0.25 } },

mutations.contract: A part hovered lights its bound interface partners in the touching tier: a partner whose face is overlaid ghosts behind that face, every other part goes faint -- the check's expectation is derived from the standing bindings, so it bites in both directions.
mutations.note: Declared by handoff the_model_drawn_alone_and_led_hub_hover_check_goes_green. A touching face no longer makes its part near, so the bound blade stays faint where the bindings say it ghosts.
